response.sql:
WITH qualifying_tracks AS (
  SELECT m.Name AS MediaTypeName,
         CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds AS BytesPerMillisecond
  FROM Track AS t
  JOIN MediaType AS m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId
  WHERE t.Bytes >= 10323804
), media_averages AS (
  SELECT MediaTypeName, AVG(BytesPerMillisecond) AS AverageBytesPerMillisecond
  FROM qualifying_tracks
  GROUP BY MediaTypeName
), overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(AverageBytesPerMillisecond) AS AverageOfMediaTypeAverages
  FROM media_averages
)
SELECT ma.MediaTypeName,
       ma.AverageBytesPerMillisecond,
       ma.AverageBytesPerMillisecond - oa.AverageOfMediaTypeAverages AS AboveOverallAverage
FROM media_averages AS ma
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa
WHERE ma.AverageBytesPerMillisecond > oa.AverageOfMediaTypeAverages;

assumptions.assumption: Each qualifying track contributes Bytes divided by Milliseconds, and the overall comparison is the simple, unweighted average of the resulting per-media-type averages. Casting Bytes to REAL avoids integer division; values are not explicitly rounded.
